title: Avalon Cybersouth — Type A
property: Avalon, Cybersouth, Dengkil, Selangor — Type A
description: 360° virtual tour of an Avalon Cybersouth Type A double-storey terrace house — entrance and living, open dining and dry kitchen, the staircase and under-stair area, a rear ground-floor bedroom with bathroom, then upstairs the family area and balcony, the master suite with en-suite, and two more bedrooms each served by its own bathroom.
